description: This file defines the LimitStream class which is a decorator for stream objects that allows reading a limited subset of the stream data starting from a specified offset. It implements the StreamInterface from PSR-7 and provides functionality to set reading limits and offsets, check EOF, and seek within the stream.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that limits the number of bytes that can be read from an underlying stream, starting from a specified offset.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LimitStream with an underlying stream, a limit on the number of bytes to read, and an initial offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the limited stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the limited subset of data available for reading.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific offset in the limited stream, adjusting for the initial offset and limit.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current read position relative to the start of the limited stream.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset for reading in the underlying stream.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes that can be read from the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream, respecting the limit.
